description: This header file defines CPU-specific extensions of the StackFrame structure for different architectures (x86, PPC, AMD64, SPARC, ARM, ARM64, MIPS) used in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system. It includes classes and enums for managing register states and their validity flags, as well as related stack frame information.

classes.name: StackFrameX86
classes.description: Represents an x86 CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFramePPC
classes.description: Represents a PowerPC CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFramePPC64
classes.description: Represents a 64-bit PowerPC CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFrameAMD64
classes.description: Represents an AMD64 CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFrameSPARC
classes.description: Represents a SPARC CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFrameARM
classes.description: Represents an ARM CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFrameARM64
classes.description: Represents an ARM64 CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

classes.name: StackFrameMIPS
classes.description: Represents a MIPS CPU stack frame with register state and validity flags.

methods.name: ReturnAddress
methods.description: Returns the return address as saved on the stack for the respective frame.

methods.name: RegisterValidFlag
methods.description: Static method returning the validity flag for a specific register number.
